rationale: Release v1.6.4 with the exact known Critical and High findings recorded for the native Full and Slim AMD64 and ARM64 images. Raw severity and unresolved or fixable status remain visible; any changed finding blocks publication.
monitoring: Every candidate runs Syft, Grype, the normal advisory evaluator, and exact accepted-known-risk reconciliation. Promotion verifies the digest-bound scan artifacts and reruns exact policy and acceptance reconciliation. Remediation remains tracked after release.
